summary: Reuse existing SQLite indexes for model return and invalidate roster cards on cleared usage slots

replay.detail: No claim or replay semantics change.

schema.detail: Removes the claims_model_return_attempt_index and local_observations_roster_model_frontier_index CREATE INDEX statements from store open. Adds no index, column, migration or table rewrite. Attempt reads reuse the existing claims subject/kind index with JSON residuals.

rules.detail: No admission or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Every local observation append advances the roster snapshot token, including repeats that clear pending usage slots. Read-only roster pins check at most 256 new rowids and reuse the same card Arc across heartbeat-only deltas, retaining its publication timestamp. Reader acquisition and delta SQL run outside roster cache locks; checked tokens advance only if the same cache entry is still present and unchanged. Larger intervals use the normal incremental builder. Relevant timeline and usage slot transitions still invalidate the cards.

downtime.detail: No online index creation or full-table backfill is introduced at daemon open. Already-created indexes are left in place; removal of their creation statements does not drop an installed index.

recovery.detail: No authoritative data format or recovery behavior changes.
